$comment: ProductClass.stock fixture keyed by productCode. Consumed by FakeInventoryAllocator at checkout time. Pilot 5 seeds enough stock for the happy-path pre-orders (sample-001=10, preorder-2026-spring-bag=5) and intentionally short stock for the OOS scenario (oos-pilot5-tightstock=1) so that requesting 3 units triggers InsufficientStockException.
